In 2008–09, '''FC Barcelona''' started a new era with a new manager, former captain and [[FC Barcelona B|Barcelona B]] coach [[Pep Guardiola]], who led the team to the first [[treble (association football)|treble]] in Spanish football history. After selling high-profile players such as [[Deco]] and [[Ronaldinho]], Barcelona went on to win the [[2008–09 Copa del Rey|Copa del Rey]], [[2008–09 La Liga|La Liga]], and [[2008–09 UEFA Champions League|UEFA Champions League]]. This team is widely regarded as one of the greatest teams in football history.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2019-12-19 |title=Oral history: How Barca made history with six trophies in 2009 |url=https://www.espn.com/soccer/story/_/id/37579940/oral-history-how-guardiola-co-did-unthinkable-2009 |access-date=2025-06-10 |website=ESPN.com |language=en}}</ref>
